content.thinking: Oops, the fuzz driver now uses rand_case_transport which doesn't accept big. Let me add a big=False param to rand_case_transport.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='fuzz.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("def rand_case_transport(rnd, max_events=70):","def rand_case_transport(rnd, max_events=70, big=False):")
s=s.replace("    base = rand_case(rnd, max_events=1, big=rnd.random() < 0.4) if False else rand_case(rnd, max_events=1, big=rnd.random() < 0.4)",
            "    base = rand_case(rnd, max_events=1, big=big or rnd.random() < 0.4)")
s=s.replace("    base = rand_case(rnd, max_events=1, big=rnd.random() < 0.4)",
            "    base = rand_case(rnd, max_events=1, big=big or rnd.random() < 0.4)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
source dev.sh && timeout 900 python3 fuzz.py 200 31337 2>&1 | grep -v " ok$" | tail -20
